text_en: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
text_cn: 亚当、舍特、厄诺士、

text_en: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
text_cn: 刻南、玛拉肋耳、耶勒得、

text_en: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;
text_cn: 哈诺客、默突舍拉、拉默客、

text_en: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text_cn: 诺厄、闪、含和耶斐特。

text_en: The descendants of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
text_cn: 耶斐特的子孙：哥默尔、玛哥格、玛待、雅汪、突巴耳、默舍客和提辣斯。

text_en: The descendants of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
text_cn: 哥默尔的子孙：阿市革纳次、黎法特和托加尔玛。

text_en: The descendants of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
text_cn: 雅汪的子孙：厄里沙、塔尔史士、基廷和多丹。

text_en: The descendants of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.
text_cn: 含的子孙：雇士、米兹辣殷、普特和客纳罕。

text_en: The descendants of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabteca. The descendants of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
text_cn: 雇士的子孙：色巴、哈威拉、撒贝达、辣阿玛和撒贝特加。辣阿玛的子孙：舍巴和德丹。

text_en: Cush became the father of Nimrod; he was the first to be a mighty one on the earth.
text_cn: 雇士生尼默洛得；他是世界第一个强人。

text_en: Egypt became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
text_cn: 米兹辣殷生路丁人、阿纳明人、肋哈宾人、纳斐突歆（xīn）人、

text_en: Pathrusim, Casluhim, and Caphtorim, from whom the Philistines come.
text_cn: 帕特洛斯人，加斯路人和加非托尔人，即培肋舍特的祖先。

text_en: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
text_cn: 客纳罕生长子漆冬，次为赫特、

text_en: and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
text_cn: 耶步斯人、阿摩黎人、基尔加史人、

text_en: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
text_cn: 希威人、阿尔克人、息尼人、

text_en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
text_cn: 阿尔瓦得人、责玛黎人和哈玛特人。

text_en: The descendants of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
text_cn: 闪的子孙：厄蓝、亚述、阿帕革沙得、路得、阿兰。阿兰的子孙：伍兹、胡耳、革特尔和默舍客。

text_en: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah; and Shelah became the father of Eber.
text_cn: 阿帕革沙得生舍拉，舍拉生厄贝尔。

text_en: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg (for in his days the earth was divided), and the name of his brother Joktan.
text_cn: 厄贝尔生了两个儿子：长子名叫培肋格，因为在他的时代，世界分裂了；他的兄弟名叫约刻堂。

text_en: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
text_cn: 约刻堂生阿耳摩达得、舍肋夫、哈匝玛委特、耶辣、

text_en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
text_cn: 哈多兰、乌匝耳、狄刻拉、

text_en: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
text_cn: 厄巴耳、阿彼玛耳、舍巴、

text_en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the descendants of Joktan.
text_cn: 敖非尔、哈威拉和约巴布：这些人都是约刻堂的子孙。

text_en: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah;
text_cn: 闪阿帕革沙得、舍拉、

text_en: Eber, Peleg, Reu;
text_cn: 厄贝尔、培肋格、勒伍、

text_en: Serug, Nahor, Terah;
text_cn: 色鲁格、纳曷（hé）尔、特辣黑、

text_en: Abram, that is, Abraham.
text_cn: 亚巴郎即亚贝辣罕。

text_en: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
text_cn: 亚巴郎的儿子是依撒格和依市玛耳。

text_en: These are their genealogies: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
text_cn: 以下是他们的后裔：依市玛耳的长子是乃巴约特，次为刻达尔、阿德贝耳、米贝散、

text_en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
text_cn: 米市玛、杜玛、玛萨、哈达得、特玛、

text_en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
text_cn: 耶突尔、纳菲士和刻德玛：以上是依市玛耳的儿子。

text_en: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
text_cn: 亚巴郎的妾刻突辣所生的儿子：齐默郎、约刻商、默丹、米德杨、依市巴克和叔哈；约刻商的儿子：舍巴和德丹。

text_en: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the descendants of Keturah.
text_cn: 米德杨的儿子：厄法、厄斐尔、哈诺客、阿彼达和厄耳达阿：以上都是刻突辣的子孙。

text_en: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
text_cn: 亚巴郎生依撒格；依撒格生厄撒乌和以色列。

text_en: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
text_cn: 厄撒乌的儿子：厄里法次、勒乌耳、耶乌士、雅蓝和科辣黑。

text_en: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
text_cn: 厄里法次的子孙：特曼、敖玛尔、则非、加堂、刻纳次、提默纳和阿玛肋克。

text_en: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
text_cn: 勒乌耳的子孙：纳哈特、则辣黑、沙玛和米匝。

text_en: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
text_cn: 色依尔的子孙：罗堂、芍巴耳、漆贝红、阿纳、狄雄、厄责尔和狄商。

text_en: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
text_cn: 罗堂的儿子：曷黎和曷曼；罗堂的姊妹：提默纳。

text_en: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
text_cn: 芍巴耳的儿子：阿里杨、玛纳哈特、厄巴耳、舍非和敖南。漆贝红的儿子：阿雅和阿纳。

text_en: The sons of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
text_cn: 阿纳的儿子：狄雄；狄雄的儿子：哈默郎、厄市班、依特郎和革郎。

text_en: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
text_cn: 厄责尔的儿子：彼耳汉、匝汪和阿甘。狄商的儿子：伍兹和阿郎。

text_en: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor, whose city was called Dinhabah.
text_cn: 以下是在以色列子民未有君王统治以前，统治厄东地的君王：贝敖尔的儿子贝拉，他的京城名叫丁哈巴。

text_en: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah of Bozrah succeeded him.
text_cn: 贝拉死后，波责辣人则辣黑的儿子约巴布继他为王。

text_en: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites succeeded him.
text_cn: 约巴布死后，特曼地人胡商继他为王。

text_en: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him; and the name of his city was Avith.
text_cn: 胡商死后，贝达得的儿子哈达得继他为王。他曾在摩阿布平原击败了米德杨人；他的京城名叫阿威特。

text_en: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah succeeded him.
text_cn: 哈达得死后，玛斯勒卡人撒默拉继他为王。

text_en: When Samlah died, Shaul of Rehoboth on the Euphrates succeeded him.
text_cn: 撒默拉死后，河间的勒曷波特人沙乌耳继他为王。

text_en: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor succeeded him.
text_cn: 沙乌耳死后，阿革波尔的儿子巴耳哈南继他为王。

text_en: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad succeeded him; the name of his city was Pai, and his wife’s name Mehetabel daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-zahab.
text_cn: 巴耳哈南死后，哈达得继他为王，他的京城名叫帕依，他的妻子名叫默塔贝耳，是默匝哈布人玛特勒得的女儿。

text_en: And Hadad died. The clans of Edom were: clans Timna, Aliah, Jetheth,
text_cn: 哈达得死后，为厄东族长的是：提默纳族长，阿里雅族长，耶太特族长，

text_en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
text_cn: 敖曷里巴玛族长，厄拉族长，丕农族长，

text_en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
text_cn: 刻纳次族长，特曼族长，米贝匝尔族长，

text_en: Magdiel, and Iram; these are the clans of Edom.
text_cn: 玛革狄耳族长和依兰族长：以上是厄东的族长。
